changeinfo.changes:
- Developer version K1.08 - FIXES FOR: * Rare lockup problems with goalkeeper * Joysticker more responsive in switching from header or slide * Header and slide exercises * Some problems with referee playing advantage * Some problems that occurred on disconnection * Stray scanner dots after players sent off * Weekly reset not resetting individual ratings * Funday Sunday - Rankings are fixed at midnight on Saturday UTC and remain unchanged until Monday * Possible ranking crash issue * Fix for rare penalty shoot problem * Fix for the precise position of the goal lines
- GAMEPLAY CHANGES: * Player formations anticipate future position of ball (makes it harder to break through defense) * Referee generally more likely to award fouls from behind * Limit how rapidly 'stop and go' can be used in play (some players were overusing this) * Fix for accidental exploit stop and go variant * 50 bonus rating points for each win and 20 for each draw in online play
- COSMETIC * New advertising panel * Credits changes
- Developer version K1.09 - FIXES FOR: * leaderboards not loading/syncing * separated leaderboards (one per platform)
- Developer version K1.10 - FIXES FOR: * ghost sessions in matchmaking * locks during matchmaking
